MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ethernet switch feels like a natural next purchase after my USB Ethernet adapter and network cables because it would help connect my laptop and Raspberry Pi over a wired network.",
    "The compact USB hub would make my existing accessories easier to connect, while the external drive would support laptop backups and project storage. Both add useful capabilities to my current setup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HDMI cable repeats something I already have, and the HDMI-to-DVI cable solves a display connection problem I have not shown a need for.",
    "The streaming sticks do not help with my current desk and networking work. Extra memory cards fit my Raspberry Pi interests, but I would postpone them after my recent card purchase.",
    "The larger powered hub is relevant, but I would choose the smaller hub because I currently want convenient connections without adding more equipment than I need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of electronics accessories seem to have been treated as interest in broadly related gadgets, even when those gadgets serve a different purpose.",
    "Buying cables and memory cards seems to have been taken as a reason to offer more of them, without enough attention to whether my existing purchases already cover the need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter and cable purchases together suggest an active wired-networking project, which makes equipment that connects those pieces especially useful now.",
    "I distinguish between something that suits my projects and something I need next: more memory cards could be useful later, while a switch or compact hub would help me use equipment I already own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my computer-accessory interests but missed that I currently want useful additions to my desk and wired network rather than duplicate supplies or streaming devices."
}
